name: Line A: the cylinders' rod sides
what it is: From the valve stand along the hydraulic room's wall and the port mooring station's, up, across over the door's head and to both cylinders. Oil here raises the ramp and holds it.

name: Line B: the cylinders' piston sides
what it is: Beside line A. Oil here lowers the ramp, against the load-holding valves.

name: Line C: cleats, lock
joins: HYD-10 → RMP-11 → RMP-12 → RMP-13 → RMP-14 → RMP-15 → RMP-16 → RMP-17 → RMP-18 → RMP-19 → RMP-20
what it is: To a header down each mooring station's wall and across over the door's head: every cleat is fed from it by a hose.

name: Line D: cleats, let go
joins: HYD-10 → RMP-11 → RMP-12 → RMP-13 → RMP-14 → RMP-15 → RMP-16 → RMP-17 → RMP-18 → RMP-19 → RMP-20 → RMP-34 → RMP-35
what it is: Beside line C. The two safety latches' lifting cylinders are on it too.

name: Pressure, pumps to valve stand
what it is: From the pressure block on the tank over the way to the valve stand.

name: Return, valve stand to tank
what it is: Back over the way, down beside the pressure line, aft over the lid on two posts and down into the cooler; from the cooler's other end up into the return filter, and through it into the tank.

name: Cleats' pressure, cleat pump to cleat valve
what it is: From the cleats' own block on the lid, with its relief valve, over the way to the cleat valve V2.
